survey: The calculator has a thick rounded body with a tilted front face. The display and red solar panel are recessed into its upper section; raised number and operator keys sit on the lower section. Its bottom and right edges show the body's thickness.

errors.where: Number and operator keys across the calculator face
errors.what: The keys look too front-facing and nearly equal in size despite the body receding strongly toward the top. Their broad faces flatten the keypad into a different viewpoint from the casing.

fix: Draw the entire calculator from one consistent elevated viewpoint. Project the keypad onto the tilted casing: make distant keys smaller and more foreshortened, and align their faces, rows and columns with the casing's perspective.
